proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x ha hD
  have hs0 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
  have h1 : (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a) = -b / (2 * a) - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a) := by ring
  have h2 : (-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a) = -b / (2 * a) + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a) := by ring
  have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a) := by positivity
  have hb : b = -2 * a * (-b / (2 * a)) := by field_simp
  have hc : c = a * ((-b / (2 * a)) ^ 2 - (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a)) ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, hs2]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h1, h2]
  generalize Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a) = t at ht hc ⊢
  generalize -b / (2 * a) = v at hb hc ⊢
  have key : a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = a * ((x - (v - t)) * (x - (v + t))) := by
    rw [hc]
    nth_rewrite 1 [hb]
    ring
  rw [key]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h3 : (x - (v - t)) * (x - (v + t)) < 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        have := mul_nonneg ha.le hn
        linarith
      rcases mul_neg_iff.1 h3 with ⟨h4, h5⟩ | ⟨h4, h5⟩
      · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro ⟨h4, h5⟩
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith))
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h3 := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left ha).1 h
      rcases mul_pos_iff.1 h3 with ⟨_, h5⟩ | ⟨h4, _⟩
      · right
        linarith
      · left
        linarith
    · rintro (h4 | h4)
      · exact mul_pos ha (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith))
      · exact mul_pos ha (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
